'''Nettle soup''' is a [[soup]] prepared from [[Urtica dioica|stinging nettle]]s. Nettle soup is eaten mainly during spring and early summer, when young nettle buds are collected.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.smithsonianmag.com/arts-culture/stinging-nettle-soup-87199507/|title=Stinging Nettle Soup|last=Fiegl|first=Amanda|date=2010-05-04|work=Smithsonian|access-date=2018-07-24|language=en}}</ref> Today, nettle soup is mostly eaten in [[Scandinavia]], [[Finland]], [[Iran]], [[Ireland]], the [[United Kingdom]], and [[Eastern Europe]], with regional differences in recipe; however historically consumption of nettles was more widespread.
